subject: All-MLB Team
title: What is the All-MLB Team? Fans and a panel pick it; 2026 team revealed Nov. 11
answer: The All-MLB Team is MLB's season-end honor for the best players at each position, regardless of league. Since 2019 it has a First and Second Team, each with 9 hitters and 7 pitchers, chosen half by fan vote and half by a panel. The 2026 teams are announced Wednesday, Nov. 11, at the MLB Awards in Las Vegas on MLB Network.
body:
Each team has a catcher, first, second and third baseman, shortstop, three outfielders (with no left/center/right split), a designated hitter, five starting pitchers and two relievers. Fans and a panel of media members, broadcasters, former players and officials have equal say in the picks. Fan voting for 2026 ran from Sept. 28 to Oct. 9, 2026, at mlb.com/allmlb; the nominee list included 91 All-Stars, 15 rookies and 44 previous All-MLB honorees.

The teams are revealed at the fourth annual MLB Awards, held at The Chelsea at The Cosmopolitan of Las Vegas and shown on MLB Network at 9 p.m. ET. The same show presents the Hank Aaron Awards, Comeback Player of the Year, the Rivera and Hoffman Reliever of the Year Awards, the Edgar Martinez Outstanding Designated Hitter Award and Executive of the Year.
in_the_news: The 2026 All-MLB First and Second Teams will be revealed on Nov. 11, 2026, at the MLB Awards show in Las Vegas.

faq.q: How many players are on the All-MLB Team?
faq.a: 16 per team: 9 hitters and 7 pitchers (5 starters, 2 relievers), with a First and a Second Team.
